doc.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jamming with Tony Williams and Don Alias
summary: A trio jam with Don Alias and Tony Williams before Tony joined Jackie McLean.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: because Bill Fitch (the conga player) and Don were tight. So I found myself in a trio jam with Don playing conga and Tony playing drums. Also, Don played bass, too, so it was piano, bass, and drums. We played a couple of times before Tony went off.
